If Γ>0, the minimum varies strictly at second order in any direction of weights of null first variation. Refines the sensitivity of P46 rem:resweights in this norm; it does not give the sign on the original weights.

213, selection 035. Average of twists: exact duplicate of G2_B8_R2 §3.2. Compressing the complete profile from T to T₀<T before averaging certified forms shifts every first contact to at least (T/T₀)log 2; the continuous part does not create the missing atom at log 2. Exact identity discarded for mixtures of finite variation when 2T>log 2. See SELECTION_035.md.

213, selection 035 (domination). Three primitive bumps of joint diameter smaller than log 2 prove that a unit compression from T to T₀<T, with arbitrary modulation, increases W by at least log(T/T₀)−o(1) on those tests. The direct lower bound by normalized averages of such energies is discarded, even if required only in the target primitive sector. Detail in SELECTION_035.md.

213-035, scale-by-scale correction. For 2T>log 2, two copies of a primitive triple separated by log 2 isolate the contact c(log 2)=1/2. After subtracting log(1/a) from each compressed energy, a necessary gap ≥(log 2)/√2−o(1) remains, uniform in scale and modulation. It discards that correction as a route to direct domination; it does not decide the sign of W. Proof in SELECTION_035.md.

213-036-A. If Γ>0, the Mellin transform of every extremizer has in Re s>1/2 only the obligatory simple zero s=1. Reflecting an additional zero preserves B∞ on the critical line and strictly lowers I on Re s=0; the causal convolution verifies membership in X₀. The reflection operation already appears in P46 thm:nyq-cone; the result restricts the profile of 034. It does not prove the global sign.

213-036-A, strip for the optimal profile. If Γ>0 and λ₊=sup B∞/I, every optional zero in Re z>0 satisfies Re z≤λ₊/[2(λ₊+Γ)]. Dividing the Mellin transform of the eigenstate by s−z produces a test v with (1/2−Re z)B∞(v)=Γ Re z I(v). It includes and exceeds the critical line; the simple mean zero at 1 is excepted. Audited CONDITIONAL result.

213-036-A, filters with a pole on the left. With Vγ(s)=U(s)/(s+a−iγ), a>0 fixed, the value inf_u sup_γ (B∞/I)(vγ) is exactly a/(a+1/2) times the original minimum. A negative extremizer gives an identical negative quotient at all centers. It is an audited reformulation: it remains unproved that every profile admits a center of nonnegative energy.

213-036-A, iteration of the filter. For an eigenstate, B₂=λ[(a²/d²)I₂−I₁/(4d³)], d=a+1/2. On the same X₀ a compact real model of three evaluations has negative minimum, negative first filter and positive second filter at the same center. A favorable center after two filters does not by itself contradict the existence of a negative extremizer.

213-036-A, large centers. For fixed width and logarithmic derivative g∈H¹ of the half-line, γ²B∞(vγ)→B∞(u), while γ²I(vγ)→I(u)+|g(0)|²/(2a). A hypothetical negative smooth test still gives negative filtered energy for all sufficiently large |γ|. The remaining interval depends on the test. Audited proof in ROUND_036_A.md.

213-037-A. For each fixed width, Γ>0 is equivalent to the existence of a single smooth compact real test, with both moments null, whose energy after the first filter is ≤−c/(1+γ²) at all centers. One fixes a regularization that commutes with the filter before approximating in X₀. In this carrier the filtered arithmetic tail is expressed through ΣΛ(n)n^(−1−a+iγ) with a finite correction. The signed estimate for the original weights remains OPEN.

213-037-A, compact lattice. If Γ>0, a common delay preserves negativity at all centers and, at γ=2πk/D, turns each filter exactly into a primitive test of one and the same finite window. The comb has common cutoff exp(D)/δ. Parseval gives the exact sum of energies as a positive multiple of B∞(F). The delay already appears in selection 027; the simultaneous margin comes from 037. No universal window bound.

213-038-A. The full operator A of 033 is of trace class: ||A−A_L||₁≤C/√(1+log L) by Hilbert–Schmidt factorization of the centered contact. Its trace is exactly (2/3)ξ′(2)/ξ(2)>0. The difference between trace norm and trace is twice the negative spectral mass; the equality between the two remains OPEN.

213-038-A, trace with dilation. For k(r)=exp(r/2)Tr(A S_exp(−r)), its Laplace transform equals [zk(0)−(ξ′/ξ)(1/2+z)]/(z²−9/4). The sign is equivalent to k(r)≤k(0) eventually by Landau; a pointwise excess would certify a negative direction. The correlation criterion of a profile reappears. The eventual upper bound remains OPEN.

213-039-A. The sign is equivalent to a one-sided bound for a finite sum: at x=j⁴, Σ_{n≤x}(1−(n/x)³)Λ(n)/n² ≤ −ζ′(2)/ζ(2)−3/(2x)+O(x^(−3/2)). The prime measure has favorable sign on the interpolation barrier between samples of k. Only the equivalence has been proved; the uniform arithmetic estimate remains OPEN.

213-039-A, samples j^m for every fixed m>0. The same one-sided arithmetic sum of 039 on any mesh of fixed powers detects the supremum θ=sup(Re ρ−1/2): the limsup of the positive growth exponent of the normalized error on the mesh is θ. Analytic proof by Hadamard, control of increments and Landau, outside the elementary convexity argument. It does not establish θ=0.

Scope of 039: the analytic corollary for arbitrary exponents lies outside the sandbox of the phase. Within it, for each integer m>4 nonnegative weights are constructed with equality at all samples j^m and intermediate normalized excess of order j^(m/2−2). Convexity alone does have threshold four; the countermodel does not represent Λ.

213-039-A, explicit threshold. H(log x) is evaluated by partial fractions, obtaining a necessary bound for E(x) with specified constants and finite sum for each x>1. The proper powers contribute to Q exactly 2/3+o(1) (squares) with contribution O(x^(−1/6)) from orders ≥3. The uniform one-sided bound for the primes remains OPEN. A single rigorous violation of the full threshold would suffice to falsify the sign.

213-039-A, continuous certificate. For all reals 16≤x≤2²⁰, the difference between the explicit trace threshold and E(x) exceeds 1/1000. Exact sieve, Arb at 160 bits and convex interpolation remainder on 960 cells. Reproducible in verify_039_interval.py. It certifies the scalar on this interval; no extension of the window T.

213, selection 040. In 039 the fixed divisorial minorant Df(t)=Σ_m f(mt), f≥0 continuous, forces f=0 already when testing only n=2,x=j⁴. With f signed of fixed compact support and global comparison, a single interval of omitted primes costs at least order √x in Q. The exact inverse changes sign and recovers the recorded Möbius inversion. Discarded as a minorant without remainder.

213-041-A. Positive divisorial minorant chosen by scale: exact maximum with support n≤N by successive minima over p,p²,... . With N∼λx^(3/2) the loss relative to Q of 039 is 2/3+1/λ+o(1); without cap it is 2/3+o(1). It reaches O(1) precision but the lower bound for the optimal value remains the arithmetic obligation on the primes.

213-041-A, exclusively composite support. The optimal loss in the minorant of 041 remains O(1) if and only if N≳x^(9/4). Necessity by the scarcity of small partners of the primes in (δx^(3/2),2δx^(3/2)]; sufficiency by fractional matching of distinct primes. The construction reproduces the first-level capacities and does not prove the uniform bound of 039.

213-042-A. Explicit positive minorant for 041 using divisibility by p≤Y=x^(3/4)/(log x)^(1/8). On the integers free of those factors a single multiple of (x/n)² computed by Euler product is subtracted; all free rows d>1 are saturated exactly before truncating. For N∼λx^(3/2) the truncated value attains the optimum of 041 up to o(1). The uniform lower bound for the sieved sum is missing.

213-042-A, periodic average. On the translates of the coprimality indicator entering the minorant, the mean of the value is (2e^(−γ_E)+o(1))√x and the variance O(log x), while the original phase has leading term (3/2)√x. Only O(log x/x) of the phases can reach (3/2)√x−C for fixed C. The mean loses in the leading term. The error of the original arithmetic phase remains to be controlled.

042-A, partial average: one can average a subset B of primes in (Y/2,Y] while keeping the original phase on the rest. The cost is [1−∏_{p∈B}(1−1/p)]V₀+o(1), uniformly. Preserving O(1) precision is equivalent to |B|=O(Y/√x); averaging the full band costs order √x/log Y.

213-043-A. Inclusion-exclusion in the untranslated sieve of 042: with k∼α log x/log log x, 0<α<1, the absolute Bonferroni error is x^(1/2−α+o(1)). Odd depth with α>1/2 retains a minorant at distance o(1); α<1/2 loses O(1) precision. The result estimates the truncation error, not the sign of the truncated value.

213-043-A, optimality among counting polynomials. For k∼α log x/log log x and 0<α<1, even the smallest weighted L¹ error among all polynomials in r(n) of degree ≤k is x^(1/2−α+o(1)). It also holds for pointwise minorants; proof by finite differences and integers with each exact count. It does not cover coefficients that distinguish the identities of the primes.

043-A, distinct weights per intersection. In the cube of the first k+1 primes, a mixed difference and the realization of each vertex by n=dq, q>Y, give L¹ loss ≥x^(min(1/2−α,3/4−2α)−o(1)). For α<3/8 the deficit of any pointwise minorant of that degree diverges even with different coefficients per set of primes; the interval [3/8,1/2) remains undecided for that class.

213-043-A, minorant weighted by the remaining logarithm. Multiplying Bonferroni by the fraction of the logarithm contributed by primes >Y exactly suppresses the integers with all factors small. The error of this construction is x^(min(1/2−α,3/4−2α)+o(1)), 0<α<3/4; k odd and α>3/8 in that range give loss o(1). It uses the small valuations and log n. The lower bound for the signed value remains OPEN.

213-044-A. [Criterion in a finite band of primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_044_A.md). Subtracting the homogeneous interpolation of 039 at floor(j/2)⁴ and (2j)⁴ eliminates both tails. The proper powers cost O(1) and the discrete maximum principle recovers the bound of 039. The uniform lower bound of the local sum of primes with constant additive error remains OPEN. No change of window.

213-044-A, divisorial minoration in the already compact band. At the even scales the Möbius inverse of the hat has a corner at 1/(16p) for each prime p: the other two contributions carry μ(16p)=μ(256p)=0. Every minorant by a fixed signed continuous profile of compact support away from zero loses Ω_f(√x) in the normalized sum over primes. Discard for that class; it does not close the deficit of 044.
With both endpoints of the support of the profile fixed, inversion on an interval below the support also gives a uniform positive integral loss for the whole class. The transfer to the prime samples remains per fixed profile.

213-045-A. [Cost of the adapted divisorial profile](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_045_A.md). At each scale one can construct a continuous global minorant with equality on the whole sampled band t≥1/x. Every nonzero continuous profile of compact support away from zero that globally minorizes a band of this type by Df has strictly negative integral: the balance would force null even inverse moments and the sign below the band forces nullity. No uniform bound of the signed sum nor of the proximity to the balance.
045-A, approximate balance. With the classical Mertens bound for μ obtained from quantitative PNT, the correction below the first sample can be made of arbitrarily small mass, even weighted by powers of |log t|. The integrable inverse has integral zero and first logarithmic moment ∫W. The compact minorants approximate both while preserving exactly all the samples. The required quadrature discrepancy remains OPEN.

213-046-A. [Localization of the quadrature in k<j](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_046_A.md). For x=j⁴ the centering log(k/j) is exact by two zero-mass identities. The positive logarithm has two-sided error O(x/j²)=O(√x) by the variation of the derivatives of the dilated hats. It only remains to control the deficit of the negative logarithm, with j−1 samples of the inverse and an integral down to zero. Equivalence of criterion; global bound pending.

213-047-A. [Localization with O((log x)²) exterior samples](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_047_A.md). A single compact average of the band keeps all the relevant poles of the bridge 038. The lengths 1/(n(n+1)) simultaneously control all the derivatives of the weight and of the cutoff; the quadrature of the upper part costs O(x exp(−c√K)). With K=A(log x)² only the deficit of the lower part remains. The analytic bridge of 038 is used; the sign of the deficit and the enlargement of the window remain pending.
047-A, refinement: summable lengths proportional to 1/[n(log(n+1))^(1+δ)] reduce the cutoff to Oδ(log x (log log x)^(1+δ)) for fixed δ>0. The infinite convolution of uniforms already appears in phase 159, G2_B6_R2; the application here is to the arithmetic band and its quadrature.

213-048-A. [Alternating finite criterion](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_048_A.md). The cutoffs K and 2K at x and 2x exactly cancel the lower integral of 047. It suffices to bound from above an odd-minus-even finite sum at j⁴; interpolation and PNT recover the global bound by iteration. The prime terms grouped by product exceed by themselves the admissible scale, so that compensation with composites is required. No proof of the sign and no additional window.

213-049-A. [Two factors close to the root](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_049_A.md). The positive contribution of the primes of 048 depends on the center and can vanish. Null divisibility rows, with bounded correction on L<d≤2L to cancel the mean density, eliminate every k≤L=⌊√x⌋; 047 bounds the tail over each progression. Signed criterion with both factors between constants times √x/(log x)² and √x(log x)². Antecedents Vaughan/type II; the bilinear estimate remains OPEN.

213-050-A. [Products with small squarefree part](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_050_A.md). Concentrating on primes only the compensation over (L,2L], the absolute cost of all the pairs of 049 with km=s r² and s squarefree ≤x^(1/4−ε) is Oε(√x). All perfect powers can also be suppressed. Products with large squarefree part remain; the sign of their sum remains OPEN.

213-051-A. [Cancellation when the prime of a row repeats](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_051_A.md). Absolute elimination for sf(km)≤x^(1/3−ε); the family k=p³v, m=pw prevents paying the endpoint ηx^(1/3) in moduli for each η>0. Summing in w with its sign, the whole sector e≥2, p|m costs O_A(√x/log^A x); e=1, p|m costs O(√x) in moduli. A criterion remains on rows with p∤m, all with sf(km)≫√x/log⁴x. The signed estimate is made on complete rows.

213-052-A. [Signed cutoff by product and subsum of primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_052_A.md). In the repeated rows e≥2 the estimate of 051 is uniform on cutting by sf(km)≤S, separating a gcd dividing v and applying PNT for coprime Möbius with moving endpoint. One can remove from the original criterion sf(km)≤c√x/log⁴x at signed cost O(√x). In the rows 3L<p<4L, the cofactors q,2q with q prime together give a positive subsum of order x/log²x; remaining compensation OPEN.

213-053-A. [Compensation by the largest prime of the cofactor](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_053_A.md). In the marked rows 3L<p<4L, the whole sector t=vm with a prime q>√t has the same positive principal term as q,2q of 052. The complement, with all its primes ≤√t, has the opposite negative principal term. Their sum is O_N(x/log^N x); the compensation to O(√x) remains OPEN.

213-053-A, root precision. The integral of the high part of the alternating row is zero. 047 gives o(L) in 3L<p<4L before excluding p|m; on excluding it, C₁L+o(L) remains with explicit positive constant.
213-054-A. [Second difference and two null densities](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_054_A.md). Applying 2−S₂ twice gives a lower criterion with α(v)=1−4·1_{v≡2 mod 4}. The density of α and that of the logarithmic divisibility term are zero. This eliminates all the rows q≤√x without the compensating coefficients of 049. One-sided return by two PNT iterations. Remaining bound OPEN.

213-055-A. [Cancellation against periodic models](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_055_A.md). For the row weights R(q) of 054 the sum of moduli of their totals per class is o(1), uniform in d≤x^(1/2−η). The mean is controlled by 1*α=ε*ε and alternation in the long variable; at mean zero the largest scale measured in periods intervenes. Λ can be replaced by Λ−1 in the complete criterion. The signed bound with the prime fluctuation remains OPEN.
055-A, range refined by means of the Gevrey partitions of 047: the sum of moduli per class remains o(1) uniformly up to d≤c√x/(log x)², for fixed c sufficiently small.

213-056-A. [Symmetric Möbius criterion off the diagonal](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_056_A.md). The simultaneous elimination of the divisors up to c√x/log²x uses 055 by individual periods. A form in μ(d)μ(m) remains with d,m in the same range and an auxiliary factor w≪log⁴x. The diagonal has asymptotic C_diag√x+o(√x) by alternation and squarefree density. The uniform upper bound for the pairs d≠m is missing.

213-057-A. [Compensation of the diagonal by rational quotients](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_057_A.md). For sf(dm)|P, P squarefree ≤(log x)^(4−δ), the block with diagonal equals C_diag√x ∏_{p|P}(1−2√p/(p+1)) with error O_A,δ(√x/log^A x). C_diag is strictly positive. The growing primorials compensate their whole principal contribution, but the constants per quotient are not absolutely summable, already at p/1. No estimate of the complement.

213-058-A. [Obstruction to the cutoff by size of the slopes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_058_A.md). The signed subsum of 056 with sf(dm)≤log x is Ω±(√x log log x) on the fourth powers. The series of the coefficients of 057 has denominator ζ(z)²ζ(2z); a multiple pole gives oscillation by Landau. No fixed nonzero smooth average of compact support in log of the radius rescues the one-sided bound, by counting of zeros. Discard of this order of grouping, without adverse conclusion for the complete form.

213-059-A. [Simultaneous centering of all the slopes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_059_A.md). Subtracting C_diag/C_unit from both logarithms preserves the inversion and cancels the principal term of each slope, avoiding the discard 058 in the new representative. The sum of moduli of totals per slope for ab≤L^(2/3−ε) is o(L) with bounded aspect at the original cutoffs, or for all aspects with K=L^(4/3), D=cL^(2/3). Larger slopes and global sign OPEN.

213-060-A. [Average over fourth-power scales and slopes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_060_A.md). The sum over x/k⁴ of the complete form without cutoffs preserves the one-sided sufficiency (multiplier ζ(4s)). In each slope it combines t squarefree and k in n=k²t, leaving only parity of valuations for p|ab. For each δ>0 the sum of moduli of totals per slope with ab≤L exp(−δ√log L) is o(L), L=√x. Criterion without individual balance; the bound on the larger slopes is missing.

213-061-A. [Primes and semiprimes in the slopes of 060](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_061_A.md). Inactive mask for P⁻(r)>u*L/√r: removal in moduli up to x^(1−ε), including all the primes by combining with 060. At r≈L(log L)^(2+δ), two explicit families of semiprimes each give ≫L(log L)^δ with opposite signs. Limit of the method of sum of moduli per slope; the total signed sum remains OPEN.
061-A, inactive mask: the Gevrey regularity of order four of the centered profile extends the removal in moduli up to c₀x/(log x)^8. For prime products it is combined with 060 in the lower part.

213-062-A. [Signed compensation in the band of semiprimes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_062_A.md). In the complete interval √R≤q≤C_h L²/p³ with p≈L/√R, R=L log^B L, the representative of 060 has explicit negative balance of order R/log²L. An equivalent criterion by h differences 4−S₄ cancels h moments at s=2 and bounds that band by O(R/log^(h+2)L), o(L) if h>B−2. Global remainder OPEN.

213-063-A. [An average independent of the logarithmic width](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_063_A.md). The multiplier exp(−(1−z)^−a), 0<a<1, has a flat zero at the edge and inverse with positive coefficients of growth below exp(c√j). The one-sided inversion is justified by quantitative PNT. With this single criterion the band √R≤q≤(L²/p³)exp((log L)^(1/4)), p≈L/√R, R=L(log L)^B, costs o_B(L) for each fixed B>2. The endpoint in q grows; no uniformity in B nor global closure is claimed.

213-064-A. [Band of superlogarithmic width](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_064_A.md). Refinement of 063 for R=L exp((log L)^κ), 0<κ<a/(1+a), with upper endpoint Q_p L^(1/4). Bound o(L) by quantitative Mellin decay and dyadic PNT on complete rows. Complement and window OPEN.

213-065-A. [Sum over rows with pq≥L](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_065_A.md). For p≥√L exp(−h/2), h=(log L)^κ as in 064, and all primes q>p with L/p≤q≤(L²/p³)L^(1/4), the sum of the moduli of the balances per p is O(L/log L). Extension of 064 by Chebyshev on the moving boundary. The complement remains OPEN.

213-066-A. [Sign of complete prefixes of semiprimes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_066_A.md). For every fixed c the balance over all p<q, pq≤cx, divided by x log log x/log x converges to ∫₀ᶜ J(1/√v)dv per representative ordered slope. The limit takes both signs by the first two null moments. The upper bound at root scale fails for certain complete prefixes. It does not decide the sum without cutoff.

213-067-A. [Excesses in complete sectors, without product cutoff](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_067_A.md). For any finite filter of 062 and any fixed d≥1, the sector of d distinct primes, multiplied by (−1)^d, exceeds C x^θ for all C and θ<1 along a sequence of fourth powers. Mellin and the logarithmic term of degree d, with M_G(2)>0 of 062. The complete sector of semiprimes by itself violates the upper bound. The global form and the infinite filter remain OPEN.

213-068-A. [One copy per product at all orders](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_068_A.md). For the centered profile of 060, counting one slope per reduced product gives O(x^(1/3)) without cutoff, with expansion by residues at 1/3 and 1/4. The factor ζ(3s)ζ(4s)/(ζ(6s)ζ(s)) cancels an η of the profile and the centering eliminates the pole at 1/2. With weights λ^ω over the original multiplicities, for each 1/2<λ<1 every upper bound O(x^θ), θ<1, fails. The original case λ=1 remains OPEN.

213-069-A. [Complete rows up to reduced numerator x^θ](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_069_A.md). In an equivalent criterion by average over sixth powers and differences of exponents 1/3,1/4, the sum of moduli of balances per numerator m≤x^θ is o(√x) for each fixed θ<1/2, with all their denominators and the original multiplicities. Uniform bound Oσ(x^σ M^(1−σ)) for m≤M. Intersection with columns, endpoint θ=1/2 and sign of the complement pending.

213-070-A. [Rows by cofactor of large primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_070_A.md). For y=(log x)^B, B>1, the sum of moduli of complete rows of 069 with cofactor of primes >y at most x^θ has exact limsup exponent 1−(1−θ)/B also on x=j⁴. It permits removing without size cutoff all those numerators when θ<1−B/2. The critical equality and the sign of the remainder remain OPEN.

213-071-A. [Failure of the control by moduli at the critical equality](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_071_A.md). At θ=1−B/2, 1<B≤2, rows of each sign reach in modulus at least √x exp(c log x/log log x). For B<2 both families coexist at every large x; for B=2 sequences of fourth powers are obtained per sign. The pending equality of 070 is resolved for the moduli; signed balance and global sign OPEN.

213-072-A. [Compensation between complete sectors by large prime](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_072_A.md). For the equivalent representative U of 069, the rows whose numerator contains a prime q>√(x/v₀) sum exactly to −Σ_q U(x/q). Their balance is −D x/log³x and that of the complement +D x/log³x, both with error O(x/log⁴x), D=Û''(1)>0. Signed compensation at the same scale; root precision OPEN.

213-073-A. [Complete recurrence and root cost of composite prime powers](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_073_A.md). Writing U=μ*Φ, with Φ explicit, the difference E of two sums (one with primes of exponent one) satisfies E=(log x)U+Σ_{p,k≥2}(log p)U(x/p^k). The normalized mass of the composite powers tends to 1/2, versus 3/2 in the arithmetic allocation of 069. One-sided equivalence by the Landau bridge; the upper bound of E remains pending.

213-074-A. [Criterion of lone primes and necessary scale in both directions](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_074_A.md). For J(x)=Σ_p(log p)U(x/p), the upper bound O(√x log x) on fourth powers is equivalent to the sign, even replacing J by −J. The double pole at the first visible zero forces positive limsup and negative liminf after that normalization. The other sum of 073 is eliminated from the pending condition; uniform bound OPEN.

213-075-A. [Cutoff of the prime sum before centering](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_075_A.md). Under the sign, the two stretches of J separated at p=x^a have opposite profiles of scale x^((1+a)/2), of both signs even on j⁴. A smooth block p≈P after subtracting the continuous density does cost O(√x) under the same hypothesis. Conditional diagnosis: it does not provide an unconditional bound for J.
075-A, assembly: for h(z)=τ(z)−τ(z/2), the one-sided ceiling C√x common to the centered blocks P=2^j, at x=j₀⁴, is equivalent to the sign. The telescoping sum subtracts a density whose multiplier is regular at the zeros and preserves the double pole of 074. It is not necessary to bound the density separately.

213-076-A. [Fixed block and detection with both scales diverging](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_076_A.md). An admissible partition of 075 already detects the whole sign at P=1. For real scales P and any smooth positive profile of compact support, an off-line zero forces unbounded excursions of D_P(x)/√x even with P→∞, x/P→∞ and x=j⁴. It is proved by means of the residue of a second transform in P. No prescribed growth law for P(x) nor unconditional bound.

213-077-A. [Regularity of minimizers and power modulus in T](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_077_A.md). The complete minimizers extended by zero have uniform H^s norm on compact subsets of T for 0<s<1/2. The exterior crossing of the archimedean kernel is controlled by Carleman and the equation at high frequencies is inverted in H^s. The floor λ_W is locally Hölder for each exponent α<1, improving the logarithmic modulus of P46 lem:contT on minimizers. No new window nor global uniform constant was computed.
077-A, provenance: phase 121 (P121_DYADIC_RADICAL_BOOTSTRAP) already contains the sub-H^{1/2} regularity by Carleman and inversion of high frequencies; 106_123 treats the second logarithmic moment. The retained application is the two-sided Hölder estimate of the complete floor with uniformity on compact subsets of T.

213-078-A. [Floor by inverse moment and error of the means per cell](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_078_A.md). Jensen in 1/ξ² and Wirtinger give an archimedean floor m(π/h) on the complement of one ordinary mean per cell. The archimedean eigenvalues at length L lie between m((k−1)π/L) and m(kπ/L), with negative count up to one unit. For the complete floor, 077 and stationarity give nonnegative Ritz error O(h^(2s)(1+|log h|)) for s<1/2 on compact subsets of T. The crossing and the global sign remain OPEN.

213-079-A. [Uniform crossing and explicit enclosure of the complete minimum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_079_A.md). On the mesh of 078 the archimedean crossing has norm <45 by the variance of the symbol on the Fourier fibers. With b_T the majorized norm of comb and pole, Schur gives a computable enclosure from λ_h, m(π/h)−b_T and 45+b_T, convergent for fixed T. A uniform positive bound or a concrete certificate in another window is missing.

213-080-A. [Correction of the crossing by cell vector](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_080_A.md). The variance of the complete nonpolar symbol on the mesh gives a Schur matrix majorant, also bounded by L_h² Δ*Δ with L_h=O_T(log(1/h)). The polar crossing has norm ≤2h sinh(T)/π. On the whole line, the archimedean crossing on means of an H¹ profile has asymptotic h log(1/h)||f'||/√12. Sufficient test; no new window nor H¹ hypothesis on minimizers.

213-081-A. [Essential edge of the comb and limit of the separated floor](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_081_A.md). The compressed comb with positive sign has norm (1+o(1))e^T by weighted Schur and PNT; the recurrence of the modulations preserves its upper endpoint on every complement of finite codimension. Even with the optimal floors separated, the proof by cells of 078–080 requires log N≥(1−o(1))e^T as T grows. This identifies the cost of the separation; the joint sign remains OPEN.
081-A closes the constant of P211-6A: the asymptotic interval [1/4,1/2] for π_+(P_T)/A_T of ROUND_006_A is reduced to the limit 1/4. The lower cosh test and the transport by codimension are prior; the upper side is closed by Schur with that weight.

213-082-A. [Polar cancellation and archimedean cost on the same test](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_082_A.md). On the whole domain, |polar−C_T| as a form is bounded by Ce^T(exp(−c√T)||F||²+(Arch−m(0)||F||²)/√T). The bounded operator has norm ∼e^T, but its action from the full polar plane costs O(exp(T−c√T)), including the crossing. It excludes saturation with energy o(√T); it does not sign the global balance.

213-083-A. [Truncated exponentials and zero strip](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_083_A.md). For F=exp(±at) on [−T,T], a>0, eventual positivity of the complete form is equivalent to |Reρ−1/2|≤a. Under that condition the first pair of zeros pays all the negative contributions, with explicit floor 1.9·2a tanh(aT)/(a²+γ₁²) after normalizing. Unconditional for all windows and a≥1/2; it is a result for each profile and not for their combinations. No new zero strip.

213-084-A. [Uniform compactification of thirteen fast poles in all windows](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_084_A.md). For n≤13 and rates v≥31.5, even confluent, W(f 1_[0,L])>||f||²/8000 for L≥log11, with truncation error <2·10⁻⁸||f||² paid in the three parts of W. Together with the window log11 already reproduced, there is positivity in this subspace for every L>0. No uniformity in the order and no mixing of opposite orientations.

213-085-A. [All dimensions with bounded reciprocal sum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_085_A.md). For Σ_j1/v_j≤1/512, every strictly proper rational causal combination with those poles, truncated to any length L>0, satisfies W≥||f_L||²/4. Reflection of the Blaschke product gives temporal control independent of the order. It includes fixed infinite-dimensional subspaces in form norm. Concentration fails at fixed rate and growing multiplicity; general sign OPEN.

213-086-A. [Exact limit window of the rate budget](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_086_A.md). With Σ1/v≤S, rates ≥V and free dimension and length, the Rayleigh infimum converges to λ_W(S) as V grows. Localization up to length 2S and recovery in form norm with repeated poles n/S. Quantitative corollary: for S≤3/4 and V≥10000 one obtains W≥5·10⁻¹⁹||g||² in ALL lengths. The general case remains OPEN.

213-087-A. [Quantitative comparison for each list of poles](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_087_A.md). For S=Σ1/v in a compact set and V=min v large, the minimum at length 2S and the infimum over all lengths of the same list are at distance O(V^−β) from λ_W(S) for every β<2/3. The phase approximation depends on Σv^−3, without separation or special choice of the poles. There is no uniformity in growing windows nor new sign bound.

213-088-A. [Threshold for two exponentials of opposite orientations](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_088_A.md). For a≥1/2 and each sign separately, W_T(exp(at)±exp(−2δT)exp(−at))≥0 eventually is equivalent to |Reρ−1/2|≤δ, including the boundary case. With δ=0 each parity alone detects the global sign and its limsup exponent of negativity coincides with sup Reρ−1/2. The upper bound of this rate holds only in the exhibited family; it does not resolve general Q4.

**Retrospective cross-check of 213-046/047.** Before proposing Möbius inversion, quadratization or centering by blocks for the interior remainder, compare the identity of the deficit in [045](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_045_A.md), the exact elimination of its integral by two scales in [048](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_048_A.md), the resulting quadratic form in [056](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_056_A.md) and the fixed block that already detects the whole sign in [076](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_076_A.md). Re-obtaining any of those representations leaves the uniform one-sided bound pending. The cross-check classifies those specific transformations; it does not discard an additional inequality on their terms.

213 selection 089. [Odd parity of 088 on a lattice](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_089.md). A symmetric spectral quartet produces eventually positive energy at each nh and negative between samples. The symmetries and summability alone do not justify replacing all the windows by that lattice in the odd criterion.

213-090-A. [Detection in families of steps](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_090_A.md). For each parity of 088, eventual positivity on r_n h for a non-meager set of h is equivalent to the sign if r_n grows to infinity with ratios tending to one. If the sign fails, a residual set of steps detects both parities infinitely often. The arithmetic hypothesis remains to be established.

213-091-A. [Detection with a fixed cosh on any lattice if the extremum is attained](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_091_A.md). With Δ>0 attained, cosh(t/2) has quotient ≤−c exp(2Δnh) at indices with bounded gaps for each h>0. The sign of the extreme coefficient at phase zero avoids requiring non-resonance. Continuous antecedent for the variable minimum in phase 159 G2_B5_R5.

213 selection 092. [Quadratic bias in the logarithmic prime sum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_092.md). The comb of 212-57 C1 already includes the crossing. By the integrated explicit formula and 088, Σ_{p≤x}(log p)log(x/p)≤x eventually is equivalent to the sign. The omitted squares contribute (2+o(1))√x. The arithmetic inequality remains OPEN.

213-093-A. [Criterion by prefixes of primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_093_A.md). With H=Σ log p and Q=Σ log²p on each prefix, Q≥H log H−H eventually is equivalent to the sign. It is obtained by maximizing each line of the criterion of 092 and the cost of evaluating at the last prime is computed exactly. The one-sided bound for the prefixes remains OPEN.

213-094-A. [Prefixes in descending crossings](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_094_A.md). For the criterion of 093 only B_n≥0 on p_n<H_n<p_(n+1) is needed. A failure would produce positive maxima with no bound for S−x there. With tolerance C√x the crossings shift according to H_n=x+C√x/2. The estimate of the excess in those gaps remains OPEN.

213-095-A. [Size of the excess at the original crossings under attained extremum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_095_A.md). If b=max(Reρ−1/2)>0 exists, every large band [X,KX] contains a maximum at H_n and a minimum at a prime with opposite excesses of order X^(1/2+b). The recurrence used in phase 159 and 091 preserves the scale on locating both arithmetic extrema of 094.

213 selection 096. [Two integer prefixes of equal product and gap](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_096.md). On removing primality, even with exact logarithmic weights, distinct integers and strict crossing, two prefixes with equal mass and common endpoints admit opposite margins ≫H/log H. The exchange uses composite factorizations.

213-097-A. [Maximum over sets of pairwise coprime integers](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_097_A.md). The maximal gain over the prime sum of 092 is unconditionally asymptotic to 3x^(1/3), below the root scale. It suffices to bound by x eventually the weighted sum of any coprime set in [2,x]. The global bound remains OPEN.
The audit resolved the maximum exactly: M(x)=Σ_{j odd≥1} j S(x^(1/j)), by separation into prime powers and independent optimization of exponents.

213 selection 098. [Cost of positive mixtures of counts of multiples](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_098.md). On 1≤t≤4, majorizing log t by a positive mixture of floor(t/u), u≥1, costs an explicit constant in L¹(dt/t²). For a fixed mixture this produces excess of order x only at the primes between x/4 and x.

213 selection 099. [Obstruction for positive binomial carries](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_099.md). No fixed distribution of binomial splittings makes it possible to represent log t by a positive mixture of its dilations. For the symmetric splitting the required density is −1/t already in (13,14). Approximate majorizations remain OPEN for this class.

213-100-A. [Separation for adaptive carries by conservation of sizes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_100_A.md). Every locally finite positive mixture, even with scale-dependent proportion, has weighted L¹ distance ≥ε from log on some fixed compact set. The conservative accumulated quantity is nonnegative for mixtures and changes sign for log. Band and constant existential. Dyadic antecedent in phase 212 round 095 §3.

213-101-A. [Majorization on prime samples and size of the splittings](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_101_A.md). If each part has proportion ≥η>0, the loss of order x persists for mixtures varying with x and majorization required only at the primes of a fixed band. Without that restriction any nonnegative prime list can be interpolated exactly by means of almost degenerate carries.

213-102-A. [Threshold of additional coverage of squares](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_102_A.md). Exact minimum cost S(x)+2λS(√x) for simultaneous demands of primes and of a fraction λ of squares. The ceiling x is equivalent to the sign for λ<1−D/2 and fails unconditionally for λ≥1−(D/2)(1−1/392), D=2+γ_E−log(4π). A band of width D/784 remains between both conclusions.

213-103-A. [The cubes decide the contact of the threshold](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_103_A.md). Under RH the ceiling of 102 also holds at λ*=1−sup(−J)/2, with margin ≥3x^(1/3)−O(x^(1/4)). For λ=1−D/2 the eventual ceiling is equivalent to the global sign, including the endpoint. The unconditional bound is missing.

213-104-A. [Criterion on primes larger than x^a with a fixed](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_104_A.md). For each 0<a<1 it suffices to control Σ log p log(x/p) over x^a<p≤x by x−x^a−(1−a)x^a log x eventually. At a=1/2 the cost of the centered prefix is o(√x) unconditionally. For a>1/2 the return preserves a pole to the right of a sup Reρ, without requiring an attained extremum.

213-105-A. [Exact ceiling in a band of ratio four](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_105_A.md). For the logarithmic hat on [x/4,x] centered at x/2 it suffices to prove that the weighted prime sum does not exceed its integral x/4 eventually. Under RH the margin exceeds 0.034√x eventually. The second difference is recovered with positive weights; antecedent of localization in 044.

213-106-A. [Minimal width for a ceiling equal to the integral](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_106_A.md). For every nonzero positive continuous weight of logarithmic band L<2π/(3γ₁), the prime sum exceeds its integral by at least c√x along a sequence, unconditionally. A single critical zero gives the obstruction uniform in the profile.

213-107-A. [Explicit weight in a band of ratio less than 2.412](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_107_A.md). The logarithmic hat tilted by t^(−1/2) with h=11/25 preserves all the poles off the line and under RH admits eventual margin 0.022√x. Certificate of a hundred pairs and complete tail by means of the Hadamard identity. The unconditional arithmetic ceiling is missing.

213-108-A. [Joint restriction of 33 frequencies](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_108_A.md). A positive matrix of residues, with 31 non-vanishings certified by balls, forces excesses of root scale for every positive weight of band of ratio ≤1.20484. Improves the exclusion of 106; without the Riemann hypothesis.

213-109-A. [Local criterion at prime centers, with exact interpolation](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_109_A.md). In a band of ratio exp(0.88), a piecewise affine weight at the center x makes the discrepancy between consecutive primes convex. It suffices to prove the ceiling of the integral at each large prime. The transform preserves the poles of the whole open strip and the bound under RH is certified with a hundred pairs and the complete tail.

213-110-A. [Local criterion at prime centers with mass balance](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_110_A.md). Only the centers q with −log q≤R−rL≤r log q require a reciprocal bound, where L,R are the neighboring logarithmic masses and r=exp(11/25). The maxima of E(x)/x satisfy that filter. The arithmetic implication remains OPEN.

213-111-A. [Prime ceiling verified on a continuous interval](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_111_A.md). E(x)<0 for every real x between 2 and 999983 with the weight of 109. Of 3130 filtered centers, 267 fail the stronger reciprocal ceiling of 110 even while satisfying the original. Certificate reproducible by sieve and balls.

213-112-A. [Unconditional bound for 109 on all of 10¹⁰≤x≤10¹²](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_112_A.md). With the finite verification theorem, high Hadamard tail and a certificate of squares on 180000 cells one obtains E≤−0.008 V(1/2)√x. The primes of order x are not sieved nor is global RH assumed.

213-113-A. [Continuous prime ceiling from 2 up to 10¹²](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_113_A.md). The squares and cubes certified on 9216 cells cover entirely the gap between 111 and 112. Explicit margin from 999983. The result is for the weight of 109.

213-114-A. [Unconditional control of the tail from the fourth root](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_114_A.md). For the weight of 109, by Ingham density and Korobov–Vinogradov region, the whole block |γ|≥x^(1/4)/(log x)^A costs in moduli o(√x/log^K x) for fixed A,K. A late excess requires signed contribution of zeros to the right below the moving cutoff.

213-115-A. [Detection without attained supremum and sequential return](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_115_A.md). Modulated Gaussian averages isolate an exponent with penalized frequency. If Δ>η≥0, M_A(T),M_W(T)≥exp(2ηT) in EVERY large window, without attainment of Δ. Resolves the sequential converse of phase 159 for exponents with loss. At the original crossings of 094 the one-sided bound O(√H_n) suffices, also without attainment.

213-116-A. [Long intervals of excess in each band of powers](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_116_A.md). Without RH, for every small δ>0 and 1/2<α<sup Reρ, the excess of 109 exceeds t^α on intervals of length y^(1−δ) in each late [X,X^(1+ε)]; the opposite sign also occurs. It suffices to control a mesh with any fixed saving of a power in the step, on a sequence of those bands.

213-117-A. [Floor ceiling with growing local quadratic density](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_117_A.md). Under D₂(y)≪log^κ(2+|y|), the upper rate of the negative minimum is ≤min(1/2,Δ+κ/2). For growth below every power of the logarithm, the rate of both forms converges to Δ by 115. Extends U₂ of phase 159 by means of the archimedean cost on negative vectors; the uniform hypothesis remains OPEN.

213-118-A. [Exact law with decreasing derivative penalization](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_118_A.md). In both forms the rate of the penalized floor is Δ with no additional density condition, even with ε_T=exp(−exp(√T)). A rate above Δ in the original form would require witnesses with doubly exponential Sobolev norm. The upper bound without penalization remains OPEN.

213-119-A. [Exact rate in even Dirichlet matrices of polynomial dimension](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_119_A.md). The first ceil(T³) even cosines, with or without primitive condition, detect the rate Δ in each large window without penalization. A subexponential bound of their negative parts on a sequence would suffice for the sign. Such a bound is not proved.

213-120-A. [One row and the diagonal of the Dirichlet matrices](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_120_A.md). The divided differences recover all the crossings at cost O(N⁴) in matrix norm. An absolute subexponential ceiling for only 2N−1 data on a sequence T→∞ is equivalent to the sign. That arithmetic estimate remains OPEN.

Antecedent correction for 213-120: lemma combsine of paper 46 already has the divided-difference identity for the Dirichlet comb by parity; see the cross-check added to the memo.

213-121-A. [The centered block of large primes preserves the matrix rate](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_121_A.md). For every fixed 0<a<1, in the matrices of 119 only the discrepancy of the primes X^a<p≤X, X=exp(2T), is needed to detect the rate Δ of the worst positive excess. The error in norm has rate ≤aΔ. The polar part and the continuous density are explicitly cancelled.

213-122-A. [Fixed frequency to detect each lower exponent](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_122_A.md). Two Gaussians of variance cT give primitive witnesses in even modes of frequency ≤B_η, with B_η fixed for η<Δ. The matrices of 119 and the criterion of one row and diagonal of 120 admit N=ceil(T log log(T+4)) or an even more slowly diverging factor.

213-123-A. [Two moments per interval between fourth powers](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_123_A.md). Interpolating the weighted autocorrelations of 121–122 at nodes m⁴ costs O((1+B²)(1+T)) in norm for maximal frequency B. The prime block preserves its exponent using only mass and first moment per cell. Its one-sided ceiling remains OPEN.

213-124-A. [Falsifier for the use of only the mass per cell](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_124_A.md). A density between 1/2 and 3/2 preserves all the masses at fourth nodes and produces (3/8)Φ_F(1/4)² plus polynomial error. There are primitive witnesses in the modes of 122 with excess of order exp(T/2). The defect of this model disappears on cancelling the additional moment at 1/4.

213-125-A. [Only masses per cell for the true primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_125_A.md). Truncated explicit formula and L² sampling of the discontinuous rounding error give error rate ≤max(0,Δ−1/8) against the rate Δ of the block. The conclusion uses the arithmetic structure of ψ and lies outside the falsifier 124. The one-sided ceiling of the mass matrix is pending.

213-126-A. [Oscillations of θ(mᵏ) at many nodes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_126_A.md). For fixed k, if Θ>1/2, both parts of θ(mᵏ)−mᵏ preserve exponent Θ even in upper dyadic mean. Mellin transfer of 125 and Landau. A root-size bound with ε for a single part in mean would suffice; it remains pending.

213-127-A. [Signed mean of primorials at fourth nodes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_127_A.md). The sign is equivalent to Σ_{M<m≤2M}(θ(m⁴)−m⁴)≤0 eventually. The bias by squares was already in selection 092; 125 controls the error on giving the same weight to M raw samples. Under RH the mean divided by M² lies at distance ≤0.106+o(1) from −7/3. The inequality remains to be proved.

213 selection 128. [Factorial resolution of the prime mean](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/SELECTION_128.md). To majorize the ladder of 127 on [2X,8X] with excess of area O(√X), ≫M factorials of arguments ≤16X are needed. With ≤8M arguments the arithmetic data in the upper band are reproduced exactly. The sign of the lower remainder remains OPEN.
In the first explicit band [1.50X,1.51X] the candidate of eight dilations loses ≫X after averaging, also when evaluating only at real primes (PNT).

213-129-A. [Factorial remainder below the root](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_129_A.md). Two cutoffs calibrate Stirling; quartic Weyl controls on average the centered cost of all the factorials up to d=M^(33/16), with error o(M²). It only remains to integrate the signed divisorial remainder over v≪X^(31/64); its magnitude is not controlled by its support.

213-130-A. [Factorial remainder in a band with two moving endpoints](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_130_A.md). Two coefficients at 2D and 4D cancel the constant and reciprocal sums; Weyl uniform in the real argument allows removing v≤X^(1/128) in absolute value at cost o(√X), preserving the upper cutoff O(X^(31/64)). The central remainder remains signed and OPEN. Direct factorial antecedent R162_801.

213-131-A. [Localization around X^(1/3)](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_131_A.md). For any δ>0, positive averages with compact Fourier support in odd extension exactly cancel the factorial kernel below cX^(1/3) and pay the tail over X^(1/3+δ) at cost o(√X). The sign is equivalent to the one-sided root ceiling with ε for the resulting family; that ceiling is not known.

213-132-A. [Joint excursions of the primes and of Mertens](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_132_A.md). Cancelling two moments of the average eliminates the Möbius correctors. Abel in both variables bounds the remainder by the product of local discrepancies. If Θ>1/2, θ(v)−v and Mertens(d) reach in modulus the exponent Θ at the same logarithmic scales with log d/log v→2. A joint improvement is missing.

213-133-A. [Exact local exponent of the Mertens increments](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_133_A.md). In each band [Z,B=Z^(1+h)], h fixed, the largest increment in modulus has rate log(1+L)/log B→Θ, even if Θ=1/2. Combines the detector of 115 with 132 and the power error of 131. A sequence of bands with exponent ceiling 1/2 is missing.

213-134-A. [Bands by harmonic Möbius crossing](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_134_A.md). There are infinitely many D with |Σ_{d≤D}μ(d)/d|≤1/D. On [D,D²] the drift of the exact quadratic identity costs ≤1 and its diagonal ≤D, uniformly on each subinterval. A bound D^(1+o(1)) for the off-diagonal differences on a subsequence is missing.

213-135-A. [Maximal bound in translated windows](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_135_A.md). The off-diagonal term of 134 has maximum of increments ≤D^(1+ε) in a proportion tending to one of translations over a period (for each ε>0). A bounded model of small harmonic balance reaches ≫D² in the anchored window. The specific transfer for μ at s=0 is pending.

213-136-A. [Multiplicative anchoring and sector of two primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_136_A.md). The maximum in the original window has root bound with high probability for independent prime signs, even fixing those of p≤log²D. For real μ, the sector with two primes alone in the squarefree part of ab produces a positive increment ≫D²/log²D: compensation between sectors of opposite parity is indispensable.

213-137-A. [Fixed multiplicative falsifier for the anchoring](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_137_A.md). Changing prime signs with arbitrarily small reciprocal sum one obtains a single f with defect Σ_{n>1}|(f*1)(n)|/n arbitrarily small; at infinitely many cutoffs of moment ≤1/D its anchored excess is ≫D²/log²D. Mixed difference of two groups of balanced signs. The case of exact inversion remains OPEN.

213-138-A. [Transfer to the root threshold](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_138_A.md). If g=f*1 and its inverse converge absolutely with weight n^(−b) for all b>1/2, the oscillation of the double sum of floors detects Θ on any sequence of windows. It includes Liouville, whose defect lives only on squares. Each isolated norm at σ>1/2 admits falsifiers of arbitrarily small cost and excess ≫D^(2σ)/log⁴D. The arithmetic estimate of the floor is missing.

213-139-A. [Liouville boundary and alternating sum in the two coordinates](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_139_A.md). The whole boundary is equivalent to a line in √x with error ≤2D. A filter that cancels that line transforms the double divisor into an alternating hyperbola; r≤x^(1/3) costs O(√x) absolutely. The one-sided bound on larger r is missing; induction by moduli diverges already at the primes.

213-140-A. [Positive theta weight and exact cancellation in Liouville](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_140_A.md). A single weight W>0 reduces the one-sided bound to μ on [X/(10 log X),10X log X], with tails o(√X); it is exactly equivalent to three dilations of the Liouville exponential sum, or a sum of λ with null coefficient on 16|n. The root ceiling with ε remains OPEN. Direct antecedent of 139: ε*ε in 054/055 and η² in 057.

213-141-A. [Two positive weights and the critical level of Möbius](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_141_A.md). On keeping only odd roots, the positive theta weight corresponds to λ on 4∤n with positive weight. At infinitely many crossings of Σμ(r)/√r with 1/ζ(1/2), the block r≤D divided by √X equals √π/(4ζ(1/2))+O(D^−1/2), uniformly in X≥2D log D. The one-sided ceiling of the remainder is missing.

213-142-A. [Crossings of the critical level in each band of powers](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_142_A.md). Gaussian and finite contour of 1/ζ: in each large [Z,Z^(1+h)] H crosses 1/ζ(1/2) in the uncentered convention. The last admissible cutoff of 141 has log D/log X→1. The signed sum on (D,10X log X] remains.

213-143-A. [Lower density of crossings of the critical moment](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_143_A.md). In [Z,Z^(1+h)] there are at least (γ₁/π−o(1))h log Z alternations. If a zero exceeds the real parts of all those of height ≤G, γ₁ can be replaced by G. Without an attained maximum of real parts the density diverges. An arithmetic ceiling of crossings or the bound of the tail is missing.

213-144-A. [Short Liouville mean with zero threshold](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_144_A.md). A finite Liouville datum with positive weights and variance j log(j+2), j=floor(log₂ log x), tends under RH to 1/ζ(1/2). Outside RH it changes to positive in each late dyadic band of log x, by Gaussian composition and 143. Unconditional eventual negativity remains OPEN.

213-145-A. [Unconditional sign of the complete average at linear variance](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_145_A.md). With V=1.25·10^(−25)log x, Z1–Z2 of P46 certify the negative bias and the first oscillatory term at every sufficiently large scale. The threshold c* for V=c log x is sup 2b/(γ²−b²) over b=Reρ−1/2>0; its nullity and the sublinear variance of 144 remain OPEN.

213-146-A. [Complete Liouville average with variance ≤1/12](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_146_A.md). Multiplying the Gaussian of 145 by sinc⁴(3y) and normalizing unconditionally preserves the negative bias and bounds the logarithmic variance uniformly. The spectral support of the factor is [−12,12], below the first ordinate of Z1. The weight differs from the detector of 144; its negativity does not close the sign.

213-147-A. [Bounded-variance detector with the same limit profile as 146](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_147_A.md). At auxiliary variance j log(j+2), the cubic edge of the Fourier transform of the sinc⁴ factor preserves every pole off the line with loss exp(−Oρ(V)). The eventual sign is equivalent to the target. It is separated from the unconditional average by a positive weight of asymptotic mass 1/(24V); its arithmetic integral remains OPEN.

213-148-A. [Certified interval of degrees of the Liouville average](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_148_A.md). For d≤1.25·10^(−25)T the quadratic weighted by any normalized polynomial square equals 1/ζ(1/2)+O(exp(−10^(−24)T)), uniformly. A subexponential ceiling at each d≤κT is equivalent to the sign; a pole off the line is detected by approximating a modulation by Taylor. The other slopes remain OPEN.

213-149-A. [Polynomial ceiling and cancellation of verified ordinates](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_149_A.md). With c unchanged, the original Liouville quadratic satisfies the polynomial ceiling up to d≤T/2000. An independent translation of variance <0.06 moreover restores the uniform negative bias at those degrees and preserves the detection off the line on considering all the slopes.

213-150-A. [Fixed theta average of Liouville](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_150_A.md). An odd perturbation of a fixed positive density preserves all the poles on the right as simple poles. Under RH the negative bias dominates the absolutely convergent series of residues. An eventual ceiling of the average implies RH by Landau. Realization of the logarithmic-derivative criterion already indexed; direct arithmetic estimate pending.

213-151-A. [Spectral tail of the odd correction](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_151_A.md). Unconditional formula with secondary residue at zero and tail O((1+H)^A exp(T/2−πH/4)). Quantifies up to what scale a verification of height H helps the fixed average of 150. Constants not evaluated; no enlargement of the window.

213-152-A. [Drift of the squares in the odd correction](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_152_A.md). With K inverse of B, the powers of exponent ≥3 contribute O(1), the squares contribute −aT/2+O(1) to E and the sign requires an excess ≥−aT/2−O(1) in the sum of simple primes. The continuous density contributes exactly zero over the complete half-line.

213-153-A. [Gaussian density of primes by squares](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_153_A.md). The ceiling for a positive sum over pn², with principal ζ(2)x/2 and secondary term ξ(1/2)√x log(x)/ζ(1/2), is equivalent to the sign. The converse uses Landau and avoids deriving an inequality. The n>√x contribute only O(√x).

213-154-A. [Point mass of the perfect squares](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_154_A.md). Completing pn² to p^k n² assigns exactly log m to each square m² through the k pairs. Unconditional expansion of the increment up to o(√x) with both constants; cancels the term √x log x of 153. Antecedent of the harmonic drift in 073. Ceiling for the complete count pending.

213-155-A. [Tilting of the average over divisors](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_155_A.md). The elementary average without tilting cancels all the poles. Each tilting m^(−d), 0<d≤1/4, preserves the extremal zero at each problematic height. Under RH the centered difference with d=0 costs O(d√x) uniformly. Its ceiling for any positive d remains OPEN.

213-156-A. [Exact scope of the divisor moments](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_156_A.md). The ceilings of scale √x of the moments 1 to M are exactly equivalent to the absence of off-line zeros with multiplicity ≤M. This delimits the route of differentiating at d=0 and avoids opening a finite tower as a substitute for 155.

213-157-A. [Interior error of the average over divisors](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_157_A.md). After integral and constant ζ(d), the remainder is positive and comparable to min(u,1). On r≤Y≤x its weighted sum has exact order Y³/x². The replacement costs O(√x) up to x^(5/6), and loses that scale above.

213-158-A. [Error per unit of tilting](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_158_A.md). For r/x small the normalized subtraction (E_d−E_0)/d has order (r/x)² with constants uniform down to d=0. The elementary weight alone has exponentially smaller error. The threshold of the prefix at tolerance d√x remains at x^(5/6).

213-159-A. [Flat weight with transform without zeros](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_159_A.md). It preserves the sign criterion of 155 and allows replacing the interior sums by integral plus constant with total error o(1) on r≤x/(K log² x), for fixed tilting. It surpasses the Gaussian barrier of 157–158; arithmetic centering pending. The Gevrey smoothing with detection is already in 047; here it is applied to m^(−d) with correction ζ(d).

213-160-A. [Joint removal of the two interior sums](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_160_A.md). A filter of dilations cancels the principal terms of the fiber mn² and preserves detection. Its complete contribution on q≤x/(K₀ log⁶x) is o(1) in total modulus. The sign of the upper band is missing; Gevrey localization already preceded by 047.

213-161-A. [The two corrections of powers in the band](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_161_A.md). The even exponents give B(1/2)√x/2 with error O_N(x^(−N)); the cubes produce B(1/3)x^(1/3)/3+o(x^(1/3)). Both coefficients are negative. All the pending ceiling is concentrated in simple primes.

213-162-A. [Correlation between distinct primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_162_A.md). The eventual negativity of the off-diagonal term in dyadic quadratic means is equivalent to the sign. For fixed small η the block |p−q|>ηX is unconditionally negative of order X² and the near block positive with equal coefficient. The decisive residual remains OPEN.

213-163-A. [Pairs at logarithmic distance](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_163_A.md). For C₀ log X≤H≤X/log X, the block of distinct pairs with jump ≤H contributes ≥cXH without hypothesis of distribution in short intervals. Taking H=(log X)² it only remains to prove eventual negativity of the dyadic complement. The macroscopic sign of 162 does not reach that complement.

213-164-A. [Threshold of distances of the far block](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_164_A.md). Unconditional negativity for H between X exp(−b log X/log log X) and X/log X. For H=X^α the threshold of eventual negativity is 2 sup Reρ−1, with equality pending. The jump to any fixed α<1 would already imply a zero-free strip of fixed width.

213-165-A. [Threshold at each scale](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_165_A.md). Upper sieve of pairs and pigeonholes give N_X(H)≍XH from C₀ log X to ηX. The first distant non-positive cutoff is measured, up to constants, by max(C₀ log X,(E_X−D_X)_+/X). At the positive critical exponent of 164 a large prefactor suffices, or prefactor one if no zero reaches the supremum.

213-166-A. [Criterion in logarithmic blocks of zero density](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_166_A.md). After a fixed Gaussian average of the prime sum, a quadratic bound on [j log(j+1),j log(j+1)+1] suffices. Integer interpolation recovers the exponent between blocks with loss exp(o(t)). Ceiling in the blocks themselves pending.

213-167-A. [Critical precision of the prime weights](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_167_A.md). Relative errors O(p^(−1/2)) preserve the energy criterion. For each β>1/2 less than one, a positive perturbation O(p^(β−1)) at the same primes preserves the bounds on pairs but introduces a pole and violates the sparse criterion of 166. Obstruction to the exclusive use of those bounds.

213-168-A. [Exactness of the divisor identity](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_168_A.md). With positive weights and the original prime support, for each η>0 a model verifies the exact identity on ≥1−η of each prefix and has exponentially controlled defect, but violates 166. A completely additive defect zero at density one is indeed identically zero. Antecedent of the modulation of 213-167: R167_102, theorem B.

213-169-A. [Sparse defect with exact moments](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_169_A.md). Rounding with bounded discrepancy and finite calibration preserve the frequency of 168, regularity of the defect on the real axis, any finite jet at one and null additive mean. A non-real pole still obstructs 166. This reinforcement of the countermodels is closed, with no advance of the window.

213-170-A. [Optimal order of the negative mass in finZ](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_170_A.md). For fixed window and set of zeros, the minimum in the sense of infimum of the negative mass of a flat-top certificate of radius L is comparable to L^(−2). The lower bound holds for any extension with that Fourier support. Constants not uniform in the list of zeros.

213-171-A. [Joint cost of radius and displacement](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_171_A.md). For fixed finite frequencies, the optimal negative mass is comparable to L^(−2)+Δ² with Δ the maximal small displacement. Curvatures of the same sign and common profile with cosh(d u)/cosh(Δu) positive definite. Antecedents finZ, R7-01 and G7E; no passage to infinite dimension.

213-172-A. [Signed extension over the complete spectrum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_172_A.md). The freedom of KEP allows summing individual costs δρ² with weight (1+|γ|)^(−k), k>1, uniformly in the number and separation of zeros. Lower bound for the complete form on smooth tests; negative part pending absorption.

213-173-A. [Tail bound in the original norm of the form](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_173_A.md). Two exact extensions in a larger window are combined by a partition with compact transform. Under verification up to G one obtains W_T≥−C(T,A)G^(−A) in L² norm for each fixed A, without derivatives of the tests. Constants not evaluated; sign pending.

213-174-A. [Threshold of sufficient height per window](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_174_A.md). For each fixed T, a fixed mask and the Fourier leakage outside a band produce archimedean margin Δ_T>0, independent of G. Verification up to a finite threshold G_T absorbs the correction of all the other zeros and implies strict positivity of W_T. No numerical comparison with Z2 nor uniformity in T.

213-175-A. [Strict positivity at T=26/25](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_175_A.md). Quantitative application of 174 with Z1–Z3 of paper 46. A high-order spectral cutoff and the reserve of archimedean density over G/2 pay the tail at G=3·10¹². Uniform L² margin exp(−700000001) for the whole form; it is not a global closure.

213-175-A, enlargement in the same memo: **W_T≥exp(−6000000001)I for all 0<T≤6/5**, both parities and complete domain. The previous frontier of the corpus was (log 11)/2≈1.1989476364 (rStation45, l.10974); 1.04 was only a calibration case. Exact parameters and Arb checks reproducible in verify_175.py.

213-176-A. [Sufficient height as a function of the window](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_176_A.md). For T sufficiently large it suffices to verify the zeros up to 100 exp(A_T+5T), where A_T is the exact mass of the comb. Hence T≤log log G−log 4−ε for G large. CONDITIONAL result uniform in the scales, distinct from the verification horizon of the symbol of paper 46.

213-177-A. [Norm of the comb and cost of height](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_177_A.md). The sum of compressed prime translates has norm (1+o(1))exp T. Filtering the test function and controlling its polar moments reduces from 4 to 1 the sufficient asymptotic coefficient: any κ>1 allows using G=exp(κ exp T) for T large. No numerical enlargement nor global closure.

213-178-A. [Strict positivity up to T=21/10](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_178_A.md). For complete W_T, floor exp(−32000000001)||f||², both parities and every 0<T≤2.1. Arb certificate of the Schur rows and of the margins at height G=3·10¹². In 177 the asymptotic norm was already proved in 081; what was new was its application to the filter.

213-179-A. [Complete window up to T=5/2](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_179_A.md). Leakage bound by three lines after averaging |f̂|² on an interval; effective parameters, Schur with rational endpoints and Arb verification. Floor exp(−9000000001)||f||² for the whole form in 0<T≤2.5.

213-180-A. [Hidden quartet and cost of height](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_180_A.md). For 0<κ<1 a real modification with functional equation preserves the zeros of ζ up to G=exp(κ exp T) and produces a direction of value ≤−(1−κ+o(1))exp T. Quantifies what is not gained by using only finite spectral data; it does not change the true result in T≤2.5 nor give necessity for ζ.

213-181-A. [Modulations with margin in the true spectrum](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_181_A.md). At G=exp(κ exp T), all but a set of measure ≤G^(1/2+o(1)) of frequencies in [2G,3G] give margin (1−o(1))log G simultaneously for unit profiles with variation ≤exp T. Bound by moments of real primes; exceptional set and rest of the domain pending.

213-182-A. [Margin in a pair of neighboring modulations](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_182_A.md). At each frequency of the band of 181 and for each admissible profile of that round, at least one of two modulations separated by π/(2T) gives margin log G−Oκ(exp(T)/T). The sum cancels up to that error the comb and the poles in norm, for the whole domain. The favorable member may depend on the profile. No individual sign on the exceptional set.

213-183-A. [Mass of all the saturators of the comb](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_183_A.md). In the critical band κ=1, a profile of 181 with W≤o(exp T) must deposit at each endpoint mass of depth (1/2)exp(−u)du in the weak limit. Consequence of the Schur deficit for the real comb, two-sided tightness and PNT. For κ<1 a necessary bound on the product of masses remains. Individual sign OPEN.

213-184-A. [Necessary alignment at primes between N and eN](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_184_A.md). For a critical BV saturator of 183 and N=exp(2T−2D), a frequency at distance ≤exp(4T) from Γ must give relative modulus ≥1−C/D²−o_D(1) in the sum of (log p)p^{iτ}. Clipped positive deficit, local transport and Plancherel. Excluding that alignment remains OPEN.

213-185-A. [Obstruction to certifying misalignment with few primes](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_185_A.md). Every fixed sample of ≤cε exp(T)/T primes of the block of 184 admits in [2G,3G] a frequency with weighted modulus >1−ε. By sampling there exists a sample of Oε(exp T) that approximates the complete average on the whole band. The misalignment of the complete block remains OPEN.

213-186-A. [Separation of peaks in the prime block of 184](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_186_A.md). Two frequencies with relative modulus ≥1−ε are at distance O(√ε) or more than N^α, for ε<c(1−α)² and N sufficiently large. Difference of phases and Brun–Titchmarsh on arcs. It permits isolated peaks and leaves the individual sign OPEN.

213-187-A. [Negativity test at a frequency with optimal relative phase](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_187_A.md). In the band log Γ∼κ exp T, the minimum at two exponential endpoints with variable phase is log Γ−|ΣΛ(n)log(X/n)n^{iΓ}|/√X+O(T+1), X=exp(2T). An excess over κ by a fixed margin in the sum divided by X would falsify the sign. Earlier weight in 212-57 and SELECTION_092. No excess proved.

213-188-A. [Optimality of the residual error of 187](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_188_A.md). At frequencies of the prescribed band both signs of the error (2+o(1))T are realized even with |S_X|/√X=o(T). Explicit internal overlap, resonator at small primes and conditional second moment at the rest. It rules out uniformly improving to o(T) by omitting the internal term. No conclusion at a saturating frequency.

213-189-A. [Complete form up to T=129/50](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_189_A.md). Schur applied to C² preserves the intermediate support of the comb. Arb certificate of 1758 endpoints and margins of the filter of 179. W_T≥exp(−20000000001)||f||² for all 0<T≤2.58, in both parities.

213-190-A. [Complete form up to T=131/50 by means of a Chebyshev filter](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_190_A.md). In the same support budget, a minimax polynomial filter amplifies the leakage of 179. Polar and spectral costs certified with Arb together with 1911 endpoints of the comb. W_T≥exp(−20000000001)||f||² for 0<T≤2.62 in both parities.

213-191-A. [Complete form up to T=67/25](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_191_A.md). Stepped Schur weight with 2048 integer inequalities over the continuous translates. At U=2.74 ||C||≤17.45 is certified and the filter of 190 proves W_T≥exp(−20000000001)||f||² for all 0<T≤2.68.

213-192-A. [Complete form up to T=68/25](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_192_A.md). Integer interior filter sinc by hyperbolic cosine, with suppression sech²(29) from G/2 and smaller support in the Chebyshev composition. Arb and 2048 integer rows certify W_T≥exp(−22000000001)||f||² for all 0<T≤2.72.

213-193-A. [Complete form up to T=553/200 and external antecedent of Durmagambetov](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_193_A.md). Mask of 192 corrected with 16 terms of the reciprocal, with certificate of strict positivity up to 2.765. Durmagambetov (202611.1382) also uses the norm of the prime operator and Schur; strict up to 1.3 and near-positivity up to 3.07, in the same radius.

213-194-A. [Strict window and POWER blocks of growing order](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_194_A.md). For min v→∞, log max v=o(min v) and limsup Σ1/v<2.765, eventual uniform positivity over all numerators, unequal or repeated poles. Truncation at H_η via vertical Plancherel of the rational basis. It includes linear rates in the dimension; the dense confluent regime remains OPEN.

213-195-A. [The floor of POWER converges to the exact floor of the window](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_195_A.md). If min v→∞ and Σ1/v→S>0 finite, the minimum of the complete rational block converges to λ_W(S), with no condition on max v. One-sided truncation with Carleman crossing and projection by interior products. Eventual positivity for S≤2.765; global sign OPEN.

Audit of 194–195: 213-086/087 already establish the effective window, with rates without maximum and two-sided comparison for each truncated list. 194 applies its floor to the certificate 193; 195 makes explicit the corollary without physical truncation. They do not constitute a new sign mechanism.

213-196-A. [One fixed rate and a block of fast rates](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_196_A.md). The limit space has a free exponential tail after the window, and the floor of W converges to its exact floor. At S=2.765 it admits strict sign for every sufficiently large fixed rate. No numerical threshold, nor enlargement of the window for arbitrary data.

213-197-A. [Crossing with the critical tail and common window for all rates](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_197_A.md). Exact ζ'/ζ–polar moment cancellation for v↓1/2 and L² limit of the crossing. A short window of common length admits arbitrary exponential tail of any rate v>1/2 with uniform margin. Near the critical rate length 10⁻⁴ is covered. It does not authorize sums of distinct tails.

213-198-A. [Arbitrary short window plus three rational tails](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_198_A.md). Uniform coercive positivity for some common length and up to three arbitrary poles >1/2, including complete collisions. A fourth auxiliary node and the non-rationality of ξ'/ξ rule out loss of the confluent margin; the escape of rates is controlled by concentration and cancellation of the arithmetic pole.

213-199-A. [Short window plus four tails and confluent margin](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_199_A.md). Bound −D_f/Δx≥min|f''|² min(T_f/(f'')²)/12 on each compact set, applied to the two factors of POWER084–085 and to the determinant relative to L². It covers collisions and escape of four rates with arbitrary prior datum. Common length existential; no passage to all orders.

213-200-A. [Arbitrary order with four free rates](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_200_A.md). Keeping the window L₄ of 199, there exists ε>0 such that Σ_{j>4}1/v_j≤ε guarantees coercivity on the whole block and arbitrary compact datum, with no dimension limit. It includes five poles with the largest sufficiently fast uniformly in the other four. The regime without budget is missing.

213-201-A. [Up to 32 arbitrary poles on the whole range](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_201_A.md). Exact sum over zeros by Hadamard and POWER001. In each high band Z3 ensures sufficiently many ordinates where the numerator is large; Markov controls the complex displacements and the denominator varies little independently of the rates. Strictly positive form for every nonzero numerator, real poles >1/2 with multiplicity, order ≤32. No global closure.

213-202-A. [Up to 4096 arbitrary real poles with uniform floor](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_202_A.md). L² sampling of polynomials by Z3 and derivation in Legendre basis. Each high band dominates a fraction of the energy and extrapolation to the low band gives W≥exp(−330000)||f||². For arbitrary order n the height sufficient to activate the band estimate is O(n³); the intermediate strip remains OPEN without additional verification.

213-203-A. [72 000 arbitrary poles and quadratic height](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_203_A.md). Relative Taylor of 1/D in discs of radius proportional to the height, valid also in the evaluations displaced by the zeros. Sampling over PQ controls bands of length A/3 without the factor exp(nH/A). Uniform floor exp(−5000000) for n≤72000; for arbitrary order the bands from max(G,150(2n+8)²) remain controlled.

213-204-A. [Height linear in the order and 500 million poles](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_204_A.md). Weighted Jacobi sampling on overlapping bands, with exact restitution by integration dA/A. Z2 suffices for n≤500000000, uniform floor exp(−35000000000); for arbitrary order a height O(n) suffices conditionally. No global proof.

213-205-A. [Scalar table: cone k≤10¹⁹N and all rows N≤10¹⁵](../03-research/phase-213-new-constructions/ROUND_205_A.md).
